What this evaluates

Which model knows how German KYC identifies a company's beneficial owners (§ 3 GwG as the BVA Transparenzregister applies it)? 300 synthetic German register extracts with euro amounts; the prompt names the law but not its rules, which are in RULES.md, each quoted from the statute or the BVA FAQ. 100 ordinary items and 200 traps: nominal-amount boundaries, direct plus controlled stakes added, two controlled vehicles beside a 50/50 holding, non-voting shares, own shares, a KG's general partner, and the fallback.

A pass of ubo-check means: The set of beneficial owners and of fictitious beneficial owners matches the key computed from RULES.md, by name; the stated basis is left to the judge.

needs review

Scoring profile two lenses: magnitude from absolute scores, direction from pairwise win rate

Two scales, two questions. The upper table is magnitude: a 1–5 score given to each output on its own, showing how big the gap is. The lower table is direction: who was preferred in head-to-head comparisons, 0–100. Pairwise is zero-sum and its denominator is only the matches each candidate took part in. 0 means "lost every match", not "bad output", and likewise 100. Both can be true at once: a candidate can narrowly lose every match (direction 0) while trailing by only 1 point on absolute score (magnitude 4.0 vs 5.0).
